2608.26005.title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
2608.26005.paper_summary: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment show three advantages: i) Accuracy: under top-5 retrieval, the left brain outperforms classical systems such as Mem0 at top-200 by nearly 30 points; ii) Emotional & Personal: the right brain, with short- and long-horizon affective attribution and dual-node persona modeling, achieves state-of-the-art performance across three persona benchmarks and improves the aggregate score by 4.29 points over the previous best system; and iii) Real-Time & Cheap: VoiceMem completes retrieval in 134 ms, well within standard VAD latency, adding no extra conversational delay while maintaining high accuracy and low cost. These results show that VoiceMem provides a practical memory foundation for real-time, personalized, and emotionally aware speech interaction.
2608.26005.paper_summary_zh: 對話系統，如雙工語音語言模型（SLMs），仍然缺乏作為其靈魂的流式、準確且具同理心的記憶系統。我們介紹了VoiceMem，一種簡單的記憶架構，具有平行的信息左腦、情感右腦和流式記憶I/O機制。我們進一步建立了一個完整的管道，用於記憶感知的SLM訓練、長期評估和具有可互換記憶後端的解耦部署。實驗和實際部署顯示出三個優勢：i) 準確性：在前五名檢索中，左腦在前200名中超越了經典系統如Mem0近30分；ii) 情感與個人化：右腦通過短期和長期的情感歸因以及雙節點角色建模，在三個角色基準上達到最先進的性能，並將總分提高了4.29分，相較於之前的最佳系統；iii) 實時與低成本：VoiceMem在134毫秒內完成檢索，遠低於標準VAD延遲，未增加額外的對話延遲，同時保持高準確性和低成本。這些結果表明，VoiceMem為實時、個性化和情感敏感的語音互動提供了實用的記憶基礎。
